sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to AFC Bridgnorth on Saturday at 15:00, looking to maintain their exceptional form. Sandbach sit top with 31 points from 13 games and have won four of their last five league matches, with only a draw interrupting their recent run. Bridgnorth, currently fifth and on mixed form (D-W-D-L-W-W), will be a stern test but the visitors' momentum gives them strong favourites status.
divisionWide: Third-placed Stafford Town host mid-table Shawbury United on Saturday, with Stafford's inconsistent recent form (D-W-D-D-W-W) meeting Shawbury's alarming slump of four losses in their last six league games. Second-place Bilston Town's absence from this week's fixture list leaves the door open for challengers. In-form Allscott Heath—winners of four straight before a recent defeat—don't feature this week. Cheadle Heath Nomads face relegation-threatened Market Drayton Town, a clash between sides struggling in the lower reaches. Brereton Social host Dawley Town in a basement battle where both sides have inconsistent recent records. At the foot of the table, struggling Foley Meir welcome already-relegated Widnes Town, the division's worst performers with just six points. Finally, Telford Town travel to Eccleshall on Tuesday evening in a fixture between mid-table sides; Eccleshall showed winning form recently (W-D-L-W-W-W) while Telford's dire form (L-D-L-L-L-L) continues to haunt their survival hopes.
